svg.title: How a second chat turn reuses the KV cache of the first
svg.desc: Turn 1 fills blocks 7, 12 and 5 with full 16-token blocks and leaves a partial last block. When turn 1 finishes or is aborted, the full blocks return to the free block queue but keep their hash and their KV values. Turn 2 resends the whole conversation, so its first three blocks have the same hashes and hit the prefix cache. Only the tokens from position 48 on, the end of the answer and the new question, are prefilled again.

g.text: BETWEEN TURNS, THE BLOCKS SIT IN FREE_BLOCK_QUEUE WITH THEIR HASH AND KV
